doc_friction.issue: Backgrounding two jobs with '&' inside one run_in_background command made the harness report completion immediately while the children kept running; it worked, but the completion notice was misleading. A note to run one job per background call would save confusion.
No mention that a cloud container can restart mid-run and kill background jobs; committing intermediate results early (as this run did) is worth suggesting for multi-step experiment drivers.
